scope: Owner-directed package update; classifications/dispositions are scoped engineering judgments, not universal semantic proof.

rows.finding_and_effect: Generalized consumer/type/sync/null/error impact checks; no MARSAD file was edited.
Preserve applicable as-of/effective-date and explicit supersession semantics; latest alone is insufficient.
Select relevant empty/zero/extreme/failure cases by contract and impact rather than mandatory universal cases.
Use actual complexity/risk/availability and measured results; model names do not establish review independence.
Bound delegated tasks with paths/contracts, outcomes, criteria, constraints and resume points as applicable.

rows.section: MARSAD target paths and merge constraints
rows.finding_and_effect: MARSAD paths and adopted force require that project owner; retain as provenance, not a new AGHR taxonomy.
Retain exact source locators and hashes; no placement-derived permission.
Nine distinct kinds, proposed force, authority, scope and effect are now explicit lesson fields.
Preserve exact owner references and COVERED/PARTIAL/MISSING/CONFLICT plus UNVERIFIED/NOT_APPLICABLE.
Generalization needs evidence for the broader context and the competent owner; reuse the existing owner file.
Add evidence/semantic checks and negative-path regression coverage; a rule is one possible outcome, not a mandatory stage.
Consumer _INBOX and Studio governance_packages/INBOX have distinct scope; derived artifacts go to their owner targets.
A new visual lesson-management product slice is outside this package update; existing Studio registration only.
Use the current intake procedure, not another parallel inbox skill.
Respect native canonical trackers; capture refuses a parallel LOCAL_JSON lesson store when external backend is declared.

rows.section: Windows portable paths and foreign encodings
rows.finding_and_effect: Portable recorded relative paths use POSIX separators; native operations use Path. Owned JSON is UTF-8; foreign claim inspection uses replacement decoding.
Advisory configurable context budgets, targeted retrieval and tool-level auditing replace universal 1000-token acceptance claims.
Freeze/check at relevant boundaries; preserve complete original candidate rather than rehash all references after every edit.
Short router links to a distinct missing learning workflow; no extra inbox skill or global instruction patch.
The mentioned attachment is absent from the eight captured inputs; no invented source or adapter qualification.

rows.section: official host version and qualification claims
rows.finding_and_effect: Verify official selected host/version/OS when source is supplied. This update makes no new Antigravity technical claim.
Adapt Scan-Generate-Dedup-Confirm-Execute with source/authority review and a later validity review.
Capture what happened, causal support, counterevidence review, prevention and a concrete detection signal.
Confidence cannot replace evidence or authority. Unknown cause remains UNPROVEN and blocks instruction-promotion preconditions.

rows.section: 3 / content approval vs write vs activation
rows.finding_and_effect: Separate capture/adoption/effect references; local fields authenticate none of them.
CANDIDATE/SUPPORTED/NEEDS_REVIEW/STALE/SUPERSEDED/REJECTED independent from execution state.
NOT_APPLIED/APPLIED/DEFERRED/NOT_APPLICABLE separate from disposition; applied claims require artifact and check evidence.
Reuse existing rules and intake; no competing policy or user-global memory store.
External commands are optional capture adapters after actual host review; no reserved slash alias or invented native command.
Inspected pinned hook code and write destinations without executing it; no installation, background collection or transcript migration.
Keep extraction, approval, effect and verification explicit; route improvements to existing procedure/skill or test.
Candidate changes and review dates block reliance; preserve previous IDs and explicit successor links.
Rejected knowledge never passes promotion checks.
Unknown approval fields rejected; malicious source prose can be captured as data without changing active files.
Exact overlap and recorded decision conflicts block new instruction promotion; semantic coverage still requires review.
Missing adoption authority, unsafe targets, changed candidate and expired applicability do not pass promotion checks.
Use original host-neutral AGHR implementation; external skill/scripts remain inspected sources only.

rows.section: retrospective triggers and Definition of Done
rows.finding_and_effect: A learning review is required at meaningful checkpoints; NO_NEW_LESSON is valid and owner pause takes precedence.

rows.section: mandatory always convert to rule and write memory
rows.finding_and_effect: No automatic global rule/skill/memory promotion; disposition follows support, scope and actual authority.
Use the existing normative taxonomy; map preferences/avoidance to applicable SHOULD/SHOULD_NOT or INFORMATIVE.
Illustration is not observed evidence here; do not impose its container prerequisite universally.

rows.section: startup brief and memory folder proposal
rows.finding_and_effect: Retrieve only task-relevant accepted guidance through existing handoff/intake; no full-history preload or duplicate memory files.
Add one complete evidence/classification workflow wrapper; no compulsory host installation or unfinished skill stub.
Reconcile against the more precise for-learning corrections; preserve the original as pending proposal.
No universal POSIX operations, blanket decoding or independent state rewrite; retain a short route to owning procedures.
Existing inbox procedure and CLI suffice; the new distinct learning skill does not duplicate them.

rows.section: 1-4 / reading result, scope, verification and authority
rows.finding_and_effect: Reuse scoped outcome/evidence/decision reporting without importing a project taxonomy.
MARSAD G/W/PR/I/V/E identifiers are project-specific examples, not universal AGHR state values.

rows.section: 11-14 / tests, review, Git and architecture language
rows.finding_and_effect: Keep tests/review/acceptance/merge/publication distinct and link evidence.
MARSAD runtime/CI facts were not refreshed in this repository; no live claims are inherited.
Use narrow conditional examples and owner decision questions without compulsory long reports for small edits.

rows.section: 25 and appendices A/B / glossary and source limits
rows.finding_and_effect: Retain educational reference status; do not copy the 260-entry project glossary into governing instructions.
Independent original hash; text extraction is review evidence, not a proof of exact semantic equivalence with Markdown.
